summary: crates/editor-snippets rev 3: two new integration test files, no production code changed. tests/adversarial_bounds.rs drives the full parse -> expand_with -> SnippetPlan::compute pipeline through every limits.rs bound as a boundary pair (exactly-at-limit ok, one-past a typed error): input bytes/InputTooLarge, nesting depth/NestingTooDeep, placeholder index/PlaceholderIndexTooLarge, distinct placeholders/TooManyPlaceholders, occurrences/TooManyOccurrences, output bytes/OutputTooLarge (via an override, so the source itself stays small); plus unbalanced/escaped braces, a trailing dollar sign, mutual self-reference, a caret past end of document, an inverted selection, and a caret mid-character in multi-byte text (each asserted against the exact PlanError/SnippetError variant, with the mid-character case also proving the valid boundary just before it still succeeds). tests/stale_identity_acceptance.rs specifies SnippetPlan/DocumentId staleness as the full revision x content 2x2 matrix (Fresh only when both match; RevisionMismatch when only revision differs; ContentMismatch when only bytes differ -- the case a naive revision-only check misses; RevisionMismatch, not a third variant, when both differ, since revision is checked first), restated once more directly against DocumentId::compare. Rev 1 (linked edits, tab order, UTF-8 structural safety) and rev 2 (SnippetPlan staleness/anchors) untouched; SnippetPlan still exposes no mutating method. 41 rev-1 + 17 rev-2 plan + 15 new adversarial + 5 new stale-identity tests + 2 doc-tests = 80 total, all passing; cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean; cargo fmt --check clean.
